import pandas as pd

# Load source tables
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_65/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_65/training_1.csv"

# Read CSVs with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
df0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)  # Columns: ['Mouse ID', 'Drug']
df1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)  # Columns: ['Mouse ID', 'Timepoint', 'Tumor Volume (mm3)', 'Metastatic Sites']

# Operation 1: JOIN on ["Mouse ID"]
df_joined = pd.merge(df0, df1, on="Mouse ID", how="inner")

# Operation 2: PIVOT
# Pivot so that each Drug becomes a column, indexed by Timepoint,
# and values are the mean Tumor Volume (mm3) for that drug at that timepoint.

pivot_df = df_joined.pivot_table(
    index="Timepoint",
    columns="Drug",
    values="Tumor Volume (mm3)",
    aggfunc="mean"
)

# The pivoted columns may not be in the exact order as target schema, reorder and add missing columns with NaN if needed
target_columns = ['Capomulin', 'Ceftamin', 'Infubinol', 'Ketapril', 'Naftisol',
                  'Placebo', 'Propriva', 'Ramicane', 'Stelasyn', 'Zoniferol']

# Ensure all target drug columns exist in pivot_df, add missing with NaN
for col in target_columns:
    if col not in pivot_df.columns:
        pivot_df[col] = float('nan')

# Reorder columns to match target schema
pivot_df = pivot_df[target_columns]

# Reset index to have Timepoint as a column
result_df = pivot_df.reset_index()

# Cast Timepoint to integer (as per target schema)
result_df['Timepoint'] = result_df['Timepoint'].astype(int)

# Cast drug columns to float (already float from mean, but enforce dtype)
for col in target_columns:
    result_df[col] = result_df[col].astype(float)

# Write the result to the specified path
output_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length3_65/target_multisource.csv"
result_df.to_csv(output_path, index=False)
